verdict: Paid campaigns paused 12 days; 28-day results hold, restart in motion.
narrative: Over the full 28 days you received 45 leads at $26.04 per lead on $1,171.64 in Meta spend — solid numbers for the window. However, all paid activity stopped on August 6th and has run at zero spend for 12 consecutive days, which is why last week shows a complete drop in leads and spend versus the week before. That pause also pulled down branded search clicks and Instagram reach, confirming those channels were being lifted by the paid campaigns rather than running independently. Campaigns are being restarted, and the pipeline intake process is being reviewed to ensure new leads move properly into active opportunities.

watch_item.issue: 33 contacts and 45 leads came in over the period, but zero moved into active pipeline opportunities — intake is not converting contacts to next steps.
watch_item.fix: The pipeline workflow is being audited this week to identify and close the gap between a lead arriving and an opportunity being created.
